newsitem.title: INDIA: India to issue 20 bln rupees of zero-coupon bonds.
newsitem.headline: India to issue 20 bln rupees of zero-coupon bonds.

text.p: The Indian government said on Wednesday that it will issue 20 billion rupees' worth of four-year, zero-coupon bonds on October 7.
The bonds will be sold at a discounted price of 60.66 rupees per 100-rupee face value, a government statement said.
The bonds will be eligible for the ready-forward facility, it said.
Subscriptions to the bonds will be received by the Reserve Bank of India in Bombay between 10:30 a.m. (0500 GMT) and 2:30 p.m. (0900 GMT) on October 7.
The statement said the issue was the second issue of the third series of zero-coupon bonds.
